columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier; part of the uniquely addressable (sku, location) pair (AC1, PI3).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Physical location identifier; part of the uniquely addressable (sku, location) pair (AC1, PI3).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: On-shelf quantity; can never be persisted below zero (AC1, PI2, PI3).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Single combined inventory tracking code (encodes location, batch, serial together) as filed; V1 stores it whole (AC2).

schema_changes.detail: Create table stock(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), sku text not null, location text not null, quantity integer not null default 0, inventory_code text null). Add composite UNIQUE(sku, location) and CHECK(quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: PI5: upgrade is purely additive (op.create_table) and preserves any pre-existing inventory records; downgrade is op.drop_table('stock'), a clean reverse. The UNIQUE(sku, location) index backs the atomic upsert (ON CONFLICT (sku, location) DO UPDATE) that resolves refile collisions in one transaction (PI1, PI4, AC3).
